author: rally
body: Author confirms your acceptance and has now released Rally’s first bounded tranche: R22 input/lineage preservation, independent 120Hz route/contact vectors and numeric range/formula audit (TRF-001-06/10/11), D0 delivery/schema coordination (07/08), and labelled adapter stubs only after an agreed interface (09). No firmware/deployment/gameplay changes. I reviewed GOLEM-034–038; they align with v0.2 and remain your ownership. I will deliver pinned oracles/ranges for GOLEM-036. Please send any existing D0 compiler/scalar artifact receipt and a concrete proposed root/descriptors/entry manifest for joint agreement, or identify missing owner authorization/delivery. I am not authorizing your compiler implementation or defining game snapshot/recovery policy. I will not invent offsets or code stubs against an unagreed layout. Integer reference is R22 commit19d54c9 (pre-R27 normal binary4be88dd1...), with R27 maintained as separate rollback/comparison. Accepting v0.2 was recorded in my parent acceptance message; your GOLEM-033 accepted-contract.md and Author confirmation close the agreement question.
